verdict.rationale: kitty's own docs state it can be extended with kittens written in Python and controlled from scripts or the shell via remote control (open windows, send text, change titles). Shipped kittens such as ssh, diff, icat and hints, including customizable matching and actions for the hints kitten, show the extension mechanism in practice, and a user reports relying on the diff and icat kittens. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the custom-kitten authoring API and lifecycle, and independent or hands-on reports of developers writing their own kittens rather than using the bundled ones.
